reviews.comment:
Es increíble que siendo socio de A.C.A no te dejen estacionar 2 minutos y era tan simple como eso , parar , pasar al baño comprar algo para comer (los chicos del full unos genios muy amables) y seguir viaje.
Ahora bien , no sé quién era porque no se identifico (una mujer bajita , morocha) calculo que sería encargada o algo por el estilo ya que estaba vestida diferente al resto del personal se negó a correr un simple cono que bloqueaba los lugares de estacionamiento (y digo "LOS" porque era más de un lugar que había) y me indico que tenía que ir a buscar estacionamiento en la calle lateral , Una falta total de respeto para el socio

(Translated by Google)
It's unbelievable that as an A.C.A. member, they wouldn't let me park for even two minutes. It was as simple as that: stop, use the restroom, buy something to eat (the guys at the service station were wonderful and very kind), and continue my trip.

Now, I don't know who it was because she didn't identify herself (a short, dark-haired woman). I imagine she was a manager or something like that since she was dressed differently from the rest of the staff. She refused to move a simple cone that was blocking the parking spaces (and I say "the" spaces because there was more than one) and told me I had to find parking on the side street. A total lack of respect for the member.
